Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 47% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 31% and 69% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle.
